## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat shortcut for a virtual location's join/access URL.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the address needs a frame, provenance, or standpoint — promote to [`gmeow:hasNetworkAddress`](gmeow-hasNetworkAddress.md) / [`NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:accessUrl`](gmeow-accessUrl.md) on a [`VirtualLocation`](../classes/gmeow-VirtualLocation.md) for the common case; [`pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) the reified [`NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) for the promoted form.
